tool.name: Biomni: Segment Cells With Deep Learning
tool.description: Perform cell segmentation on fluorescence microscopy images using deep learning.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.microbiology import segment_cells_with_deep_learning
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = segment_cells_with_deep_learning(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --image_path '$image_path' #if $model_type --model_type '$model_type' #end if #if $diameter --diameter '$diameter' #end if #if $save_dir --save_dir '$save_dir' #end if

param.name: image_path
param.label: Image Path
param.help: Path to the fluorescence microscopy image file

param.name: diameter
param.label: Diameter
param.help: Expected diameter of cells in pixels. If None, diameter is automatically estimated.

tool.help:
**Biomni: Segment Cells With Deep Learning**
Perform cell segmentation on fluorescence microscopy images using deep learning.
Uses pre-trained models from the Cellpose/Omnipose library to identify and segment individual cells in fluorescence microscopy images.
Parameters ---------- image_path : str Path to the fluorescence microscopy image file model_type : str, optional Name of the pre-trained model to use (default: 'bact_fluor_omni') Options include: 'bact_fluor_omni', 'cyto', 'nuclei', etc. diameter : float, optional Expected diameter of cells in pixels. If None, diameter is automatically estimated. save_dir : str, optional Directory to save segmentation results (default: 'segmentation_results')
Returns ------- str Research log detailing the segmentation process and results
**Domain**: microbiology **Function**: segment_cells_with_deep_learning
